ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity contrast with approximately 90% high-intensity white/cream pixels occupying the central area and 10% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels concentrated along the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous area across both lobes; dark-intensity band along the trailing edge boundary; small isolated dark focal spots located at the peduncle junction and on the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and deep vertical penetration into the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge with vertical amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels, distinct from the water interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature originating from the median notch and extending to the acute points of the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small circular dark-intensity pixel clusters localized near the central fluke junction and scattered near the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct reddish-brown linear pixel disruption on the left lobe oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small circular pockmarks and pigmentation irregularities consistent with previous focal surface disruptions or barnacle attachment sites.
